title: Craftable elytraa
description: This datapack add craft for elytra
body:
This Datapack craft elytra for minecraft in survival 1.21.7-1.21.8 
How to craft -> 1 netherite chestplate, 3 string, 2 phamton membrane, 2 feather.
This datapack ideal if you want to get an elytra but without going to end.
